27.content:
# claude.md - Delta Post Accident (tree 683028422)

## Purpose
Agent-facing Zingtree workflow embedded in Quest Diagnostics' Salesforce (Workforce Health
Solutions) that walks a Client Services agent through a Delta Air Lines drug/alcohol testing
determination and sends the resulting notification emails. Handles two event types on one tree,
selected by the inbound Salesforce query param `sf_Event_Type`:
- **Post-Accident** (default) - DOT check -> reasonable-suspicion gate -> no-testing factors ->
  per-damage-type assessment loop -> testing determination -> location rules -> emails.
- **Reasonable Suspicion** (`sf_Event_Type=Suspicion`) - signs/symptoms + role -> determination
  -> WFH branch -> case summary -> emails.

## Architecture (node map, sequential IDs)
1  Content  Incident Classification - DOT Check (ROOT) -> 2
2  Script   Evaluate DOT Factors -> sets is_dot_accident, is_suspicion -> 3
3  Scoring  DOT vs Non-DOT Routing: is_dot_accident==true -> 4 ; ==false -> 5 (cont 5)
4  Content  DOT Incident - Stop and Call Delta -> 26
5  Scoring  Reasonable Suspicion or Post-Accident?: is_suspicion==true -> 22 ; ==false -> 6 (cont 6)
6  Content  No-Testing Factor Assessment -> 7   (hours_elapsed field removed - AI-3)
7  Script   Evaluate No-Testing Factors -> sets no_testing_confirmed (+ stages no-testing summary) -> 8
8  Scoring  No-Testing Factor Routing: no_testing_confirmed==true -> 9 ; ==false -> 10 (cont 10)
9  Content  No Testing Required -> 17
10 Content  Select Damage Type -> 11
11 Script   Next Damage Type (loop cursor) -> 12
12 Content  Assessment for This Damage Type -> 13
13 Script   Save Damage Type Answers (pushes transforms.final_records) -> 14
14 Scoring  More Damage Types?: is_more_damage_types==true -> 11 ; ==false -> 15 (cont 15)
15 Script   Evaluate Testing Determination -> sets transforms.testing_summary_html -> 16
16 Content  Testing Determination Result (collects airport, member id, role, internal notes) -> 17
17 Script   Build Location Rules & Case Summary -> sets final_print_summary_html + routing emails -> 18
18 Content  Review & Send Notifications -> 19
19 Email    Email - Collector Notification (to ${collector_email}, bcc ${quest_group_email}) -> 20
20 Email    Email - OSM Notification (to ${osm_email}, bcc ${quest_group_email}) -> 21
21 Content  Workflow Complete (terminal)
22 Content  Reasonable Suspicion Details -> 23
23 Script   Evaluate Suspicion Determination -> 24
24 Scoring  Suspicion Employee Routing: rs_is_wfh==true -> 25 ; ==false -> 26 (cont 26)
25 Content  Work From Home - Call Delta Hotline -> 26
26 Script   Build Suspicion Case Summary -> sets final_print_summary_html + routing emails -> 18
27 Content  claude.md (unlinked memory node - this file)

Loop: 10 -> 11 (cursor) -> 12 -> 13 (store) -> 14 (more?) -> back to 11 or on to 15.

## Data dictionary
- **Inbound params (from Salesforce):** sf_Event_Type, sf_Id, sf_Contact_Name__c, sf_Contact_Phone__c,
  sf_Department_Number__c, and (for go-live routing) sf_OSM_Email__c, sf_Collector_Email__c,
  sf_Quest_Group_Email__c.
- **Router booleans (script-set):** is_dot_accident, is_suspicion, no_testing_confirmed,
  is_more_damage_types, rs_is_wfh.
- **Transforms:** final_records (array of per-damage answer objects), testing_summary_html,
  testing_classification, final_print_summary_html / _text (rendered by node 18 + both emails).
- **Email routing vars (staged in nodes 17 & 26):** osm_email, collector_email, quest_group_email.
  Precedence: Review-screen override (email_address) > SF-passed address > test fallback
  (emergencydispatch@questdiagnostics.com). Quest group default STC.QUEST-DAC@questdiagnostics.com.
- **SF write-back fields:** all sf_*__c answers; node 17 consolidates every per-damage answer
  (any 'Yes' wins) back to form data so the whole questionnaire lands on the case.

## External systems
Salesforce (UAT sandbox ies-questdiagnostics--zingtree). Emails sent by Zingtree.
Post-collection form is a SEPARATE tree (live/173598167), linked from the OSM email.
Accounts: DOT 80126730, Non-DOT 80126731. Delta STP/hotline 866-217-8222.

## Conventions & gotchas
- merge_vars_not_fixed = "1" - node 18 + both emails render shared ${transforms.final_print_summary_html}
  staged per path; without this Zingtree would freeze the first-rendered value.
- Routers are advanced_logic_node="1" and test only script-set booleans with explicit complementary
  expressions + continuation_node_id fallback (no blank buttons).
- Determination (node 15) guards transforms.final_records and always leaves a definitive
  testing_summary_html so the summary never shows 'Testing Summary Unavailable' (AI-4).
- The damage-type loop currently processes the single Select-Damage-Type selection; node 11 only
  overwrites damage_type when an indexed damage_type_N value exists (preserves that selection).
- Email bodies must NOT contain literal ```html fences (removed in this rebuild).

## Changelog
- 2026-07-22 · Rebuild from post-UAT call feedback (Chris LeDoux / Fahim Ziyad) · Removed 6 orphan
  dev nodes and compacted IDs 1..27; added Evaluate DOT Factors + Evaluate No-Testing Factors eval
  scripts; converted all routers to boolean script-before-router with explicit expressions;
  AI-1/2/7 questionnaire + agent notes now render in emails and all sf_*__c answers write to SF;
  AI-3 removed 'how many hours' field; AI-4 hardened testing determination; AI-5 email subjects ->
  'Delta Airlines Information - Post-Accident - ${sf_Airport_Code__c}' and stripped ```html fences;
  AI-6 configurable OSM/collector routing with Quest-group bcc + test fallback; renamed generic
  titles; set merge_vars_not_fixed=1; added this claude.md node.
